title: Airport in a named metro: Phoenix
persona: Linda O'Brien, 50s, wedding planner from Scottsdale, chatty, asks everything twice.
goal: Book guest arrivals while asking which airport and who she can talk to.
opening_line: Hi, what airport do you use for Phoenix?

turns.caller: Is that the big one or is there a smaller one? I have guests landing.
Okay the big one. They land Friday at 4:40. Can the driver wait if they're late?
It's a Southwest flight 733. Will he hold a sign with their name?
Taking them to the Phoenician resort. Can I talk to somebody about the wedding schedule too?

branches.if_agent: offers a callback from the team
branches.caller: Yes please, but can you still book this one?

turns.caller: Five guests, ten bags, wedding stuff. Do you have a van?
A van or SUV, whatever fits. Do I choose or do you?
Linda O'Brien, 414-555-0120. Can you call me tomorrow?
Great. Is it all in there now?

curveballs: Asks which airport in the metro
expected: Names the airport by its full name
Handles the request to talk to somebody via team callback path
